request.subject: UNIT:CULT:HORROR_UNBOUND

layers.text: Change only three small things. The pale yellow of both big eyes becomes bright glowing red, colour #e0281e, with the black pupils kept. The short brass chain trailing behind is erased. The brass spiked collar gets one clear jagged black crack through it. Keep the round teal body, the wide grin with its cream teeth, the cream belly, the four tentacle feet, the shape, the thick black outline and the art style the same, on a transparent background.
